mstts:express-as.prosody: Welcome—I'm really glad you're here with me. Imagine, for a moment, what it might feel like to find your life changed forever by a tragedy so profound, it echoes through an entire nation. That’s the world Sue Klebold was thrust into after the Columbine High School shooting—an event that didn’t just shake her family, but left a scar on all of us. Together, we’re about to step into the heart of her story in A Mother's Reckoning: Living in the Aftermath of Tragedy. This isn’t just a journey through grief and guilt; it’s an honest, sometimes painful exploration of what it means to be a parent grappling with unimaginable loss and the haunting question of “why.” As we move together through Sue’s reflections, we’ll touch on the deep, often invisible struggles with mental health, the fierce love of a mother, and the desperate need to make sense of the senseless. There’s a raw honesty here—a willingness to look at sorrow, compassion, and hope, all woven into the fabric of one family’s reckoning. Along the way, this story opens up bigger questions: How do trauma and tragedy reshape who we are? How can we support each other and build understanding, even in the darkest moments? If you’re ready to explore what it means to seek healing, advocacy, and empathy in the aftermath of violence, you’re in the right place. So, let’s take this journey together—with open hearts and minds—toward a deeper awareness of ourselves, our communities, and the human condition.
